gemini-4-argon.description: Gemini 4 Argon OCR — flagship reasoning model
gemini-4-argon.pricingNotes: Google lists Gemini 4 Argon Standard introductory pricing of $2/1M input and $10/1M output tokens through 2026-11-30, then $4/1M input and $20/1M output from 2026-12-01. Output includes thinking tokens. AutoShow conservatively records the standard rates, so estimates overstate cost during the introductory window. Implicit cache reads cost $0.10/1M then $0.20/1M; explicit caching and free tier are unsupported. No context price tier is published. OCR costs use observed input and candidate-plus-thinking output usage; page/timing heuristics inherited from Flash are provisional, not a per-page tariff or measured Argon performance. Batch/flex/priority/Contributor rates, cache discounts, search grounding, taxes and provider credits are excluded. Automatic date transitions are unsupported; recheck the tariff by 2026-12-01.

limits.notes: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon documents a unified 1,048,576-token input, thinking and output window and 65,536 synchronous output tokens. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/document-processing limits PDFs to 50 MB or 1000 pages, including uploads. https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/file-input-methods permits 100 MB inline non-PDF payloads and 2 GB Files uploads; actual image/context capacity still applies. Long decode and continuation are not implemented.

gemini-3.8-flash.pricingNotes: Gemini 3.8 Flash Standard pricing is $1.50/1M input tokens and $7.50/1M output tokens effective 2027-01-01, with introductory pricing of $0.75/1M input tokens and $3.75/1M output tokens through 2026-12-31 and no published context tiers. AutoShow conservatively records the standard rates, so estimates overstate cost during the introductory window. OCR estimates multiply observed token usage by these published rates. The page heuristics are reused from Gemini 3.6 Flash and are provisional until a separately approved paid calibration is available; free tier, batch/flex/priority prices, context caching, taxes, and provider credits are ignored. Automatic date transitions are unsupported; recheck the tariff and refresh all three workflow price paths by 2027-01-01.

limits.notes: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/document-processing.md.txt documents inline PDF input up to 50 MB, inline non-PDF payloads up to 100 MB, Files API uploads up to 2 GB per file, and document understanding up to 1000 PDF pages.
